title: How facade progress is modelled
question: Should facade progress use tagged zones on structural drawings or sub-structures? Can facade and interior categories be selected together on trends or progress details, what happens when the drawing changes on the details page, and which categories apply on facade sheets?
context: The facade PRD leaves nine edge cases as REVIEW_REQUIRED and asks for the pros and cons of zones versus sub-structures. No facade implementation was found (PROG-REQ-053).
options: Tagged facade zones on structural drawings with elevation drawings assigned (the PRD's current approach)
Facade sub-structures in the site hierarchy
